source_title: 12 Sustainable Practices You Can Do at Home
article_summary: The article presents practical household sustainability behaviors aimed at reducing carbon footprint, waste, water use, and home energy consumption. For green smart-home rule design, it is conceptually useful because it highlights water-saving actions, energy-efficient appliances and lighting, unplugging unused devices, and environmentally conscious behavior change. Although it does not discuss smart-home automation directly, several recommendations could inform greener IF-THEN rules such as reducing idle power, supporting efficient appliance use, and promoting water conservation.
